{{Top|leg}}
'''Micro-motivators''' were small mechanisms that emitted a stimulating burst of energy. Most often, these devices were inserted into racing animals&mdash;to artificially boost the animals' drive to continue&mdash;by [[Scoundrel/Legends|criminals]] who wished to rig a race. The micro-motivators could be demolished inside the animal without causing any harm, thereby eliminating evidence of the criminal's dishonesty.

[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] caught the gambler [[Dack|Tymmo]] inserting one inside one of [[Slish Fondine]]'s [[Umgullian blob]]s.
